entries.zh: 继续；延续不断（绵续不绝）
entries.en: to continue, to go on without ceasing; to be continuous
entries.notes: 西语『sîn casar』当为『sin cesar』（不停止）之误写，与「綿續」义合；R 栏 zōg 已划删。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（西语词头 Contra 义为「相反；反对」）
entries.en: 〔Original damaged; gloss uncertain〕 Contra = against, opposite
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏皆空，仅存西语词头与缩写 p̃，无从对译，不作推定。

entries.en: against reason; unreasonable, contrary to reason
to oppose, to defy; to disobey (one's elders)

entries.zh: 纵放；顶撞（原稿以「縱」对译，词义存疑）
entries.en: to contradict (recorded equivalent 縱; sense uncertain); to let loose
entries.notes: H 作「縱」、R 作 chōⁿg，与本条 contradecir 义不密合，M 栏又有[残]，语义难以定夺。

entries.en: to go against, to disobey; to be contrary

entries.zh: 横逆；蛮横违理、恣意横行
entries.en: perverse, obstinate, overbearing; to oppose (hèng)
to contradict one's superior; to defy an elder
entries.notes: 西语义明确，惟 H 作「徇」(zūn) 与「忤上」义不合，疑为借音记写，故降为中等。

entries.en: to be disobedient and defiant; to rebel against (authority)

entries.zh: 悖逆；反叛作乱、搅翻局面
entries.en: rebellious, seditious; to turn against, to stir up trouble
perverse, absurd; contrary to reason
mutually opposite, contrary
entries.notes: 西语『de admonicion』（作劝诫解）语义晦涩，仅得 H/R「相反」一义，故降为中等。

entries.zh: 相背；彼此相违、背道而驰
entries.en: mutually opposed; to be at variance with each other

entries.zh: 顶撞；冲撞他人（言语相抵）
entries.en: to butt against; to contradict someone (to their face)
entries.notes: M 栏末『L quy quy』为原稿旁注，未详；四栏主体于「抵撞」互证。

entries.en: to violate a prohibition; to contravene
to go against, to be disobedient
to talk back; to contradict in words
to offend / contradict the devil (or spirits)
entries.notes: 『begay』疑为他加禄语 bagay（事物），全句为西语—他加禄语混合，释义存疑。

entries.en: to oppose virtue; perverse against what is right

entries.zh: 争讼；争吵（首字残缺，释义存疑）
entries.en: to quarrel, to litigate; to wrangle
entries.notes: H 首字[残]，仅存「刁」(tiáu) 与 pleytear（诉讼、争吵）相合，释义据西语推定。

entries.zh: 顶撞；当面反驳说话的人
entries.en: to contradict someone to their face; to answer back
naturally contrary; antagonistic by nature
entries.notes: 西语『Contrario en natural』句法不全，H「激」(kek，激惹) 义亦偏，释义存疑。
